## Checklist

- [ ] Rendered locally with `quarto preview` (or CI rendered it without errors)

- [ ] Examples use public data or are self-contained, with no private cohort data, paths, or hostnames
- [ ] Claims about tools and thresholds cite the tool's documentation or a paper
